terms.title: Grimm
terms.eyebrow: Legend Dynamics · A Grimm fan game
terms.guideSubtitle: Gothic horror in the Grimm-verse, the late 1800s, for the Legend Dynamics RPG system
terms.reasonLabel: Why you stand against the dark
terms.reasonSheet: Why I stand against the dark
terms.journalIntro: Write it together at the end of a job. Advancements apply to the GM's copies; use each card's Save character file to send a player their update.
terms.journalTitlePlaceholder: e.g. The Blutbad of Cripple Creek
terms.emptyNote: Empty: it won't fire until you reload.
terms.tracksIntro: Shared by the whole group. A full woge seen by townsfolk, magic worked openly, a body left where it will be found, or a success at a cost can mark a box; lying low between cases, a good cover story or a public good can clear one.
terms.facility: A doctor's surgery with instruments, chloroform and a clean table
terms.formCoreSummary: Monstrous form: changing is a free action; strong emotion can force it (Will roll); its profile applies while changed; townsfolk who see it panic
terms.restrictedToggle: Horror campaign: show vampires as player characters (they must drink human blood; only if the whole table agreed)
terms.restrictedCheck: for horror campaigns only: tick Horror campaign if your table agreed

theme.comment: Trails of Blood & Dust, plain: weathered paper, dark ink and blood red, like the game's page on the site. No white or cream text: highlighted controls are tan with dark ink and a blood-red edge.

roles.name: Lawman
roles.text: Lawman: wears a badge or carries credentials, and brings the guilty in: a U.S. marshal, a Texas Ranger, a sheriff or deputy, a city policeman, or a Pinkerton detective. Your Allegiance says which force you serve; a Badge or Pinkerton Credentials advantage gives its authority.
ability: The badge
+2 to Leadership when you give orders in the law's name: an arrest, raising a posse, clearing a street.

roles.name: Bounty Hunter
roles.text: Bounty hunter: tracks and brings in wanted men, and the things that only look like men.
ability: Paper on them
+2 to Tracking and Investigation to find someone with a price on their head or a warrant out.

roles.name: Lawyer
roles.text: Lawyer: argues cases, draws up deeds and contracts, and knows which laws a town forgot it had.
ability: Due process
Once per case, get someone out of jail, a warrant issued or quashed, or a deed or contract into your hands, wherever there's law to work.

roles.name: Circuit Judge
roles.text: Circuit judge: rides from town to town holding court, and not every town wants one.
ability: Heard it all before
+2 to Read People to catch a lie told to your face.

roles.name: Politician
roles.text: Politician: holds office or wants it: a mayor, an alderman, a territorial delegate, a governor's man, or a party boss with friends in the capital.
ability: Friends in office
Once per case, the town or territory gives you what it can: rooms at the hotel, horses for a posse, the jail cells, the telegraph office, or the doctor's time.

roles.name: Doctor
roles.text: Doctor: patches up the wounded and reads what a body says about what killed it.
ability: Steady hands
+2 to Medicine when stabilizing the Dying or working under fire.

roles.name: Apothecary
roles.text: Apothecary: brews remedies, antidotes and stranger things, and knows which ingredients come from where.
ability: Already brewed
Once per case, you have the right remedy, poison or antidote already made.

roles.name: Scholar
roles.text: Scholar: knows the old books, the old languages and the occult, and finds the answer in a footnote.
ability: The family books
Once per case, your books have a page on this creature: one true weakness or habit.

roles.name: Occultist
roles.text: Occultist: works the old arts, knows what's out there, and knows what it costs.
ability: Forbidden lore
Once per case, ask the GM one question about a supernatural thing you've seen, and get a true answer.

roles.name: Preacher
roles.text: Preacher: comforts the frightened, counsels the troubled, and stands against the dark with faith and a shotgun.
ability: Hold fast
+2 to Will against fear, possession and temptation, and to Leadership to steady others against them.

roles.name: Monster Hunter
roles.text: Monster hunter: hunts what walks at night by study, traps and patience, not a Grimm's sight. A Grimm can be one, but needn't be, and most monster hunters aren't Grimms.
ability: Know its weakness
Once you've identified a creature with Wesen Lore, your called shots against it take no penalty.

roles.name: Gunslinger
roles.text: Gunslinger: the fastest and steadiest gun in the room, and the one who decides when it's time to draw.
ability: Quick draw
In the first round of a gunfight, you act first, whatever your Agility.

roles.name: Scout
roles.text: Scout: finds the trail, reads the land, and keeps everyone alive out in it.
ability: Lay of the land
Once per case, you know a way: a hidden pass, a water hole, a shortcut that saves a day, or a place to make a stand.

roles.name: Gambler
roles.text: Gambler: reads people, bluffs, and hears everything the saloon hears.
ability: Markers
Once per case, call in a debt: someone owes you a favor, a horse, a room or the truth.

roles.name: Tinker
roles.text: Tinker: fixes the guns, builds the traps, and makes the gadget nobody else thought possible.
ability: Jury-rig
Once per case, make the gadget, lock pick, silver-loaded shell or repair you need from whatever is to hand.

roles.name: Shotgun Messenger
roles.text: Shotgun messenger: rides beside the driver guarding the mail, the strongbox and the passengers.
ability: Riding shotgun
Once per fight, when someone next to you is hit, you take the hit instead.

skills: Command others, rally a crowd, give clear orders
Calm, train and handle horses, mules and dogs, and face down a beast
Judge motives, spot a lie, read a face
Search a scene, examine clues, follow paper trails
Statutes, warrants, courts, claims and contracts
Identify Wesen, their customs, strengths and weaknesses
Rituals, magical traditions, curses and secret orders
Brew remedies, antidotes, poisons and potions
Fix and modify guns, locks, machines and traps
Play cards and dice, figure odds, spot a cheat
Follow a trail and read signs of passage
Find water, shelter and food; manage wilderness hazards
Ride, drive a wagon, handle horses in a chase
Knives, axes, sabers and the old Grimm weapons
Climb, swim, jump, run and exert yourself
Move quietly, hide and pick a pocket
formCore: Humans see your Wesen face only when you choose a full woge.
You see other Wesen when they woge, and you see a Grimm's eyes.
A free action, in or out. Anger, frustration or fright can force one: when an enemy appears, you're frightened or you're attacked, the GM can call for a Will roll; on a failure you woge.
Ordinary people panic or attack; Persuasion with them is impossible. A full woge seen by townsfolk marks Exposure (2 boxes for a Tier 3 heritage).
−2 to Riding while woged; a horse won't carry a woged rider.
Your secret is deadly. Wesen who expose themselves answer to the Council, and to Grimms.

origins.name: Human
origins.desc: Most people are human. You know the truth about the hidden world, which already sets you apart.
traits: +2 to Will against fear when facing something that shouldn't exist.
When you tell ordinary folk what you've seen, accept being called mad, drunk or a liar.
+2 to Read People when judging, face to face, whether someone is lying.
You act on an unproven feeling. Accept the consequence when it costs time, trust or position.

origins.name: Fuchsbau
origins.desc: Fox-like Wesen, clever and quick, with a long tradition of trade in herbs, remedies and harder-to-find ingredients. Other Wesen call them disreputable, and not always unfairly.
traits: +2 to Apothecary when brewing a remedy, antidote or potion from the old recipes.
Your family deals in the Wesen black market. Accept their demands or their trouble.
+2 to Deception when misleading a pursuer or covering your tracks.
You overplay your hand. Accept the consequence when the trick backfires.
+2 to Shooting with a bow from the saddle.
Wesen assume a Fuchsbau is up to something. Accept the distrust when it costs you.
Keen senses: track by scent and hearing

origins.name: Coyotl
origins.desc: Coyote-like Wesen of the plains and desert country who live in clans bound by old customs, and fight together like a pack.
traits: +2 to Brawling or Melee against a target an ally attacked this round.
The clan's customs bind you. Accept the clan's demand.
+2 to Survival in dry, open country: plains, desert and badlands.
You can't stay put for long. Accept leaving, or the strain of staying, at a bad time.
Keen senses: track by scent and hearing
Swift: Move +1, and +2 to Athletics when running

origins.name: Eisbiber
origins.desc: Beaver-like Wesen: builders, neighbors and gossips, close-knit and peaceable, and easily frightened by violence. Bullies like the Hässlich prey on them.
traits: +2 to Tinkering when building or shoring up structures, dams or mechanisms.
Violence makes you freeze. Accept losing your first action when a fight breaks out.
+2 to Investigation when asking the local Wesen community for news.
The lodge expects favors. Accept the call when it comes at a bad time.
Teeth gnaw through wood and rope (a bite marks 1 box)
Swimmer: holds breath for minutes; +2 to Athletics when swimming

origins.name: Bauerschwein
origins.desc: Pig-like Wesen: stubborn, hard-working, with senses sharp even in human form, and old enemies of the Blutbaden. Their feud is settled, when it must be, by the Ehrenkampf, a ritual duel.
core: Sharp senses even unwoged: you can identify people and things by smell in either form.
traits: +2 to Will to resist intimidation, especially from a Blutbad.
Blutbaden are your people's enemies. When one is near, accept the quarrel, or the challenge to Ehrenkampf.
+2 to Intellect rolls to notice or identify something by smell.
Your honesty offends someone who matters. Accept the lost goodwill.

origins.name: Mauzhertz
origins.desc: Mouse-like Wesen, small, quick and wary, with excellent hearing. Gentle by nature, but one pushed too far can snap.
traits: +2 to Stealth when hiding or slipping away.
Sudden noise or danger makes you flinch. Accept −2 on your next action.
+2 to Intellect rolls to hear faint or distant sounds.
Pushed too far, you snap into violence. Accept what you do in that moment.
Keen hearing: hear whispers through walls

origins.name: Ziegevolk
origins.desc: Goat-like Wesen whose pheromones, working even in human form, make them unnaturally persuasive and unnaturally popular. A Fuchsbau remedy can protect against them.
traits: +2 to Persuasion face to face at close quarters, in either form. Grimms and anyone dosed with the antidote are unaffected.
Those who know what you are wonder whether they were persuaded or drugged. Accept the distrust.
+2 to Deception when talking your way past a guard or official.
Affairs and broken hearts trail behind you. Accept the jealous husband or the angry ex.

origins.name: Steinadler
origins.desc: Eagle-like Wesen with remarkable eyesight, a hunter's pride, and a taste for working alone, sometimes for hire.
traits: +2 to Intellect rolls to spot detail at a great distance.
You won't back down or beg. Accept the consequence of your pride.
+2 to Shooting at long range after aiming for an action.
You won't shoot an unarmed or fleeing foe. Accept the escape.
Eagle sight: see detail a mile away

origins.name: Taniwha
origins.desc: Water-dwelling Wesen from New Zealand: guardians of rivers and the people they claim, reptile-like in woge, and dangerous to anyone else. Horror campaigns only.
core: Resists poison: +4 to Body against any poison.
Hunger (horror): each season you must eat human flesh; until you do, mark a box that rest can't clear, every three days.
traits: Ability, in full woge: a bite marks 1 box, and the target rolls Body or is paralyzed for the scene.
You protect those you've claimed as yours. Accept the danger when they need you.
+2 to Athletics and Survival in rivers, lakes and the sea.
Gluttony, and an odd craving (frogs, to start with). Accept the distraction at a bad time.
Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer
Amphibious: breathes water and swims at full Move, fast as a dolphin (water isn't hard going for them; a strong current, a storm or choked water still halves it)
drawbacks: Must be submerged in water daily, or mark a box that rest can't clear, each hour
Pounamu (greenstone) wounds mark one extra box

origins.name: Blutbad
origins.desc: Wolf-like Wesen with keen senses and a predator's appetite; the root of the werewolf legend. Wesen who know your kind assume you hunt humans. You don't, or not anymore.
core: Reputation: Eats Humans. Wesen who know your kind assume the worst.
traits: +2 to Tracking by scent, in either form.
When blood is spilled near you or something runs, roll Will or woge and give chase. Accept the cost of the urge.
+2 to Stealth when stalking at night.
You shun company. Accept the cost of going it alone.
Bauerschwein are your enemies. When one is near, accept the quarrel.
Keen senses: track by scent and hearing

origins.name: Mauvais Dentes
origins.desc: Sabre-toothed, panther-like Wesen, so deadly that the Royal Families have kept them as assassins. Rare, solitary, and feared even by other Wesen.
core: Reputation: Eats Humans. Wesen who know your kind assume the worst.
traits: +2 to Tracking when hunting a single named quarry.
The Royals bred your line as killers. When one of their agents calls on you, accept the demand or the danger of refusing.
+2 to Brawling on your first attack of a fight, leaping from hiding.
In a fight you go for the throat. Accept the death you didn't intend.
Sabre teeth and claws mark 2 boxes
Keen senses: track by scent and hearing

origins.name: Skalengeck
origins.desc: Lizard-like Wesen, cold-eyed and hard to kill, with a poisonous bite. Common among outlaws and hired guns.
traits: Ability, in full woge: a bite that marks a box also poisons. Each hour the victim rolls Body −3 or marks another box, until treated with Apothecary.
You don't much care who gets hurt. Accept the cost when that shows.
+2 to Body to resist being knocked out, stunned or restrained.
When you're trapped, you woge and fight. Accept the Exposure and the damage.
Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer

origins.name: Jägerbär
origins.desc: Bear-like Wesen, enormously strong and durable. Traditional families still keep the Roh-Hatz, a coming-of-age hunt, and fight with an old Germanic weapon whose claw-like scoop disembowels.
traits: +2 to Athletics for feats of raw strength: lifting, breaking, holding.
Your family keeps the old hunting rite. Accept the obligation, or the shame of refusing it.
+2 to Melee with your family's claw-bladed hunting weapon.
Once angered, you're hard to stop. Accept the harm you do to something you shouldn't.
Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer

origins.name: Naschazer
origins.desc: Brutish, ogre-like Wesen of enormous strength who crave human flesh. Horror campaigns only.
core: Hunger (horror): each month you must eat human flesh; until you do, mark a box that rest can't clear, every day.
traits: +2 to Athletics to lift, break or hold.
Riches are hard to refuse. Accept the bribe's strings or the risk of taking more.
+2 to Melee with a cleaver, axe or knife.
You won't be slighted. Accept the fight your pride starts.
Huge strength: fists and fangs mark 2 boxes
Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer
Feels no pain: ignore the Wounded penalty
Heals fast: each day of rest clears a box, however hurt you are

origins.name: Vallachi
origins.desc: Long-lived, handsome, vampire-like Wesen who feed on the lifeforce of others and shun the sun. Horror campaigns only.
core: Lifedrain (horror): by touch, roll Will against the victim's Body; on a success they mark a box and you clear one.
Hunger (horror): each week you must drain lifeforce; until you do, mark a box that rest can't clear, every six hours.
Sunlight: −2 to all rolls in direct sun, and you tire quickly.
Lifebane: plants wilt and animals shy around you.
traits: +2 to Persuasion face to face, after dark.
You've lived long enough to make enemies. Accept it when one of them turns up.
+2 to Intellect rolls to recall something you lived through decades ago.
You don't age as you should. Accept the lie or the slip when someone notices.
Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer, except from a pointed wooden stake

origins.name: Grimm
origins.desc: A descendant of the old hunters, the Decapitare: stronger and faster than ordinary people, able to see the Wesen hidden among us, and feared by them.
core: The Sight: you see a Wesen's face when it's stirred by strong emotion.
Grimm eyes: woged Wesen and other Grimms see them; humans don't.
Uneasy sense: you feel when a Wesen or magic is near, with no details.
Never freeze: you're never surprised, and +2 to Will against fear.
Hard to bewitch: +2 to Will against magic.
Raised on the books: Wesen Lore is always at least Trained, free.
Grimm blood: a Hexenbiest or Zauberbiest who drinks it under a full moon loses their powers (see Grimm blood).
traits: Ability: when an ambush or trap threatens you, the GM secretly rolls your Intellect; success warns you in time to act.
The dead you've seen come back at night. Accept the lost sleep at a bad time.
Ability: each hit that marks 2 or more boxes marks one fewer (never below 1).
Wesen must die. Accept the trouble when mercy would be wiser.
Ability: each day of rest clears a box, however hurt you are, and rest works at three boxes even with nobody tending you.
You won't rest when there's a case. Accept the strain.
+2 to Body to resist poison, disease and exhaustion.
You won't back down. Accept the cost.
+2 to Shooting with a pistol at close range, with no need to aim.
+2 to Athletics and Melee to keep your feet or fight on bad ground.
Accept the risk your curiosity brings.
Ability: your Brawling hits mark 2 boxes.
You don't stop at the surrender. Accept the consequences.
+2 to Melee or Shooting with one named heirloom weapon.
When it's lost or taken, accept the risk to get it back.
Ability: Dying lasts until the end of the next scene, not this one.
You've sworn to protect the innocent from Wesen. Accept the danger.
You won't lie, even to Wesen. Accept the consequence.
+2 to Wesen Lore when you can consult your family's books.
The books are irreplaceable and coveted. When they are threatened, accept the risk of protecting them.

origins.name: Incantare
origins.desc: A human who works real magic through a Lens: a tradition and a way of seeing. The Wesen Council, the Royals and the Order of the Holy Knife all watch for people like you.
core: Rituals: roll Occult to fill a ritual clock (minor 2, significant 4, major 6 segments). Your Lens sets how.
Charms: you can carry as many ready charms as your Occult training allows (Trained 2, Specialty 3, Expert 4).
Grimms sense your magic: +1 to notice it for each charm or potion you carry.
traits: Brews elixirs, potions and powders ahead of time: hours to make, an instant to use. +2 to Occult when brewing. Only a Chymiater can brew the Grimm-blood draught.
Your craft feeds a vice: greed, drink, lechery or gluttony (agree which). Accept it when it bites.
Glamours, illusions and mesmerism worked through performance, music or art, in minutes. +2 to Occult for illusion and mesmerism.
You need an audience and can't bear an insult to your art. Accept the trouble your vanity causes.
Scholarly ritual from grimoires, the Sixth and Seventh Books of Moses among them: any kind of effect, but an hour per roll, and it needs books. +2 to Occult for divination and wards.
A grimoire, a ritual or a secret tempts you beyond sense. Accept the risk to get it.
Hexerei: curses and hexes, and the breaking of them, worked through a link: blood, hair or a treasured object; −4 without one. +2 to Occult for curses with a link.
People whisper that you're a hexer, and the Order of the Holy Knife listens. Accept the suspicion.
Rites of the seasons, nature and the old gods, worked outdoors; in America, often behind the doors of a Druid lodge. +2 to Occult for nature and folk magic.
The old observances bind you: festivals, offerings, taboos. Accept the delay or cost of keeping them.
Braucherei, the Pennsylvania Dutch healing craft: spoken charms, prayers and blessed objects, from The Long Lost Friend. +2 to Occult to heal, protect, or break a hex.
A Braucher takes no money for healing, only gifts. Accept the cost when the need is great and the purse is empty.
Enchants objects and works of art; the best charm-maker. +2 to Occult when making charms or enchanting an object, and you can carry one extra charm.
Moods, jealousy and obsession with your work. Accept the cost when your temper or a rival gets to you.
Casts spells: quick magic in one action and an Occult roll, shaped by one or two Paths agreed with the GM (fire and force, say). Known: Trained 2, Specialty 3, Expert 4. You can carry only one charm.
Your power follows one narrow calling. Accept the cost of serving it when it clashes with your friends' needs.

origins.name: Hexenbiest or Zauberbiest
origins.desc: Witch-like Wesen (Zauberbiest for the men), beautiful in human form and horrific in woge, with innate magic that lives in their Wesen spirit. Coven traditions bind them; Grimm blood can strip them.
core: Telekinesis: in full or partial woge, roll Will to throw a person or object with your mind (1 box), seize something out of reach, or turn aside one attack (+2 Dodge).
Innate magic: you can work rituals with Occult like an Incantare, in the Hexenbiest style: curses, potions and sendings.
Grimm blood: drunk under a full moon, it strips your powers until the Contaminatio Ritualis restores them.
traits: +2 to Occult for curses, potions and sendings.
Every spell costs blood, pain or something precious. Accept the cost when it bites.
Ability, in woge: roll Will to lift yourself and float or fly a short way.
You cannot abide being bested or slighted. Accept the feud you start.
Ability, in full woge: roll Will against the target's Body; on a success they mark 1 box, which Dodge can't avoid.
Your family or coven has rules and expectations. Accept the demand.
Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer

origins.name: Murcielago
origins.desc: Bat-like Wesen with uncanny hearing and a sonic scream that drops a room full of people to their knees.
core: Sonic scream: in full woge, roll Will. Everyone nearby you choose who can hear rolls Body −2; a failure loses their next action and takes −2 for the scene. Earplugs protect. Heard in town, it marks Exposure.
traits: +2 to Intellect rolls to find something hidden in the dark by sound.
Loud noise disorients you. When a gun or explosion goes off nearby, accept −2 on your next action.
+2 to Intellect rolls to hear faint or distant voices.
You hear secrets you shouldn't. Accept the trouble that knowing brings.
Sonar: no penalty for darkness; sense the shape of a room by sound

origins.name: Fuchsteufelwild
origins.desc: Goblin-like Wesen, green-skinned in woge with fingers fused into acid talons; the root of Rumpelstiltskin. Clever, spiteful, and bound by an old obsession with names and bargains.
core: Acid talons: in full woge, claw hits mark 2 boxes and ignore Tough and armor.
Leaper, in either form: jumps of many yards; +2 to Athletics to jump.
traits: Ability, in full woge: stomp, and everyone nearby rolls Athletics or falls and loses their next action.
When an enemy is helpless, you're tempted to make them suffer. Accept the lost allies, or the Suspicion it brings.
+2 to Persuasion or Deception when making a deal.
Your true name holds power over you. When someone hunts for it, or speaks it, accept the consequence.
Keen senses: track by scent and hearing
drawbacks: Fused claws: −2 to Tinkering, Shooting and other fine handwork while woged

allegiances: church
The Church
Once per case, shelter, records or a favor from the clergy.
Duty: the Church gives you orders. Sicarii discipline ties you to the Order of the Holy Knife.
royal
A Royal Family
Once per case, money, papers or a door opened.
Duty: an involuntary call to serve, and the family's rivals hunt you.
marshals
The U.S. Marshals
Once per case, a federal warrant, a posse sworn in on the spot, or a telegram to the district marshal.
Duty: the marshal sends you after federal fugitives, and the men you've jailed have friends.
rangers
The Texas Rangers
Once per case, a Ranger company riding with you, a warrant good anywhere in Texas, or word from a frontier post.
Duty: the Captain sends you wherever Texas is in trouble, and the Rangers' hard reputation rides with you.
sheriff
A County Sheriff's Office
Once per case, a deputy's help, the county jail, or the county records and wanted posters.
Duty: the sheriff calls on you, and the county's feuds and elections become yours.
police
A City Police Department
Once per case, a patrolman's help, a night in the cells for someone, or the station's files.
Duty: the captain gives the orders, and some of your fellow officers are Wesen with loyalties of their own.
pinkerton
The Pinkerton National Detective Agency
Once per case, an agency file on someone, an operative's help, or a client's money for the work.
Duty: the client comes first, even a railroad or a mine owner breaking a strike, and working folk hate the name.
society
A secret society
Once per case, lore, a meeting place or a fellow initiate (the Golden Dawn, the Brotherhood of the Holy Earth).
Duty and Vow: keep its secrets and follow its traditions.
council
The Wesen Council
Contacts in the local Wesen community.
Duty: the Council calls on you, and others know you're its operative.
family
A Grimm family
Access to the family books and kin.
Duty to the family name, and to fight its enemies.
reasons: The family gift
The Grimm blood woke in me, and it came with a duty.
Vengeance
Something that wore a human face killed someone I loved.
Protect the town
Somebody has to stand between these people and what's out there.
Keep the peace
Wesen and humans can live side by side, and I mean to prove it.
I saw it
I saw what I saw, and no one else believes me.
Redemption
I did harm once. I mean to balance the ledger.
The bounty
The pay's good, and nobody else will take these jobs.
Knowledge
The hidden world is the greatest mystery there is, and I want to understand it.
Faith
The Lord sent me here for a reason, and I believe this is it.
Nowhere else to go
These people took me in when no one else would.
connections: Rode together in the war
We served in the same company and still watch each other's backs.
They saved my life
They cut me down from a lynch mob's rope, and I owe them my life.
I saved theirs
I pulled them out of a burning barn, and they haven't forgotten it.
Mentor
They taught me what I know about the hidden world.
Friendly rivals
We're always competing over the same bounty, the same card game or the same sweetheart.
Same hometown
We grew up in the same town and know each other's families.
An unpaid debt
I owe them money, or a favor, and I haven't paid it yet.
A shared secret
We share a secret from a job neither of us talks about.
Saloon regulars
We meet every Saturday night for cards, whiskey and lies.
Bad blood
They blame me for something that went wrong on a past job.
advantages: +2 to Medicine for surgery or digging out a bullet. It does not improve diagnosis.
+2 to Medicine for emergency stabilization of a wounded patient.
+2 to Intellect rolls to notice a concealed physical clue during a deliberate search.
+2 to Shooting on your first shot of a fight, with a holstered revolver.
+2 to Shooting after spending your preceding action aiming at the same visible target.
+2 to Riding in a chase or on dangerous ground.
+2 to Tracking when the trail is more than a day old.
+2 to Gambling at cards, including spotting someone else's cheating.
+2 to Deception to hide what you know or feel under questioning.
+2 to Wesen Lore to identify a Wesen from what it left behind: tracks, wounds, a body.
+2 to Tinkering when repairing or modifying a firearm.
+2 to Leadership when coordinating others in a sudden emergency.
+2 to Will when resisting magic or a Wesen's influence.
+2 to Melee with a knife in close quarters.
+2 to Persuasion when calming or rousing a crowd.

Legal authority in one town or county: you can carry arms where others can't, question witnesses, make arrests and hold suspects. +2 to Leadership or Persuasion when invoking that authority with people who respect the law. Outside your jurisdiction it's just tin.

Authority across your county: everything a deputy can do, plus serving warrants, running the jail, and swearing in deputies and armed citizens. +2 to Leadership or Persuasion when invoking that authority with people who respect the law.

Federal authority across states and territories: serving federal warrants, pursuing fugitives across county and state lines, swearing in deputies, and calling on local lawmen for help. +2 to Leadership or Persuasion when invoking that authority with people who respect the law.

A commission from the Pinkerton National Detective Agency: carry arms on the job, work a client's case across county and state lines, and draw on the agency's offices and files (records, photographs and descriptions of wanted men). +2 to Investigation when using the agency's records or contacts. You have no powers of arrest beyond any citizen's unless local law deputizes you, and you answer to the client and the agency.
complications: A strange discovery tempts you to linger, spend something scarce, or take a risky look. Accept a specific cost.

You insist on arrest, trial and due process, even for Wesen. Accept the delay or danger it costs.
Pride tempts you to refuse help or take on too much. Take a real consequence when it matters.

An agreed secret threatens trust or safety. Earn a point when protecting or revealing it has a real consequence.

You seek a way that doesn't end a life, even a Wesen's. Accept the extra danger.

quickRef: Fists, clubs, knives, arrows: 1 box. Guns, heavy blades, claws: 2. Close-range shotgun or buffalo rifle: 3 and Dying.
A real shield: +1 to Block; a chair, slat, crate lid or saddle stands in. Heavy coat: once a fight, a 2+ box hit from a blade, claw, fang or missile marks one fewer.
Derringer 2, revolver 6, shotgun 2, rifle 15. Fan the hammer 3 (−2), both barrels 2 (+2 close), covering fire 3. Reload: one action. Natural 18 jams.
Silver: werewolves. Stake, fire, sunlight, beheading: vampires. Headshot or fire: zombies. Holy water: undead and demons.
Rituals: 2-, 4- or 6-segment clock, Occult rolls at your tradition's pace. Charms: Trained 2, Specialty 3, Expert 4 (Sorcerer 1). Hexes (Sorcerer): one action; Specialty 1 Boost, Expert 2, −1 each.

list: A lash of fire at Short range; marks 2 boxes. Dodge applies.
Unseen force hurls the target down: 1 box, and they're knocked down as by a telling hit: prone, or driven back a few steps, and standing up uses their next move (Body resists).
Attacks against one ally are at −2 for the scene.
The target is at −2 on all rolls for the scene (Will resists).
The target is held where they stand, as a pin: their next action goes to getting free, and then they're free. Holding them again takes another casting (Body resists).
Every lamp in a room goes out, or one gun jams; clearing a jam takes an action.
A Wesen in sight rolls Will or woges, there and then.
Stop the bleeding: clear one injury box, once per set of injuries.
spells.note: Casting takes an action and an Occult roll; each spell says whether Dodge applies or which attribute resists. A failed spell flares where people can see it: mark a box of Exposure; a natural 18 marks two.

magic.steps: your Occult training: Trained, Specialty, Expert
dials: Gothic horror: magic is old-country, slow and feared. A fight is won by the charm made last night, not the spell cast now.
Veneficare only: known Trained 2, Specialty 3, Expert 4.
Every Incantare, at their Lens's pace: ten minutes a roll; an hour for a Magi. Hexenbiests and Zauberbiests work them through their innate magic.
Incantare carry Trained 2, Specialty 3, Expert 4; a Scaenarfex one more, a Veneficare only one. Elixirs and potions spoil at the end of the day.
Exposure: a failed spell marks a box, and magic worked openly can mark one too. The Order of the Holy Knife hunts known Incantare, and a Grimm senses charms and potions.

help.step: Only a Veneficare casts spells; other Lenses rely on rituals and charms. Your Occult training sets a spell's power: Trained, Specialty or Expert.
help.charms: Incantare carry as many ready charms as their Occult training allows: Trained 2, Specialty 3, Expert 4. A Scaenarfex carries one more; a Veneficare, only one.
help.price: Magic worked openly can mark Exposure too, and the Order of the Holy Knife hunts known Incantare.

gmGuide.title: Grimm GM's Guide
gmGuide.subtitle: Running cases in the hidden West: threats and the GM's tools
gmGuide.intro: This book is for whoever runs the game: case seeds, the threats, making lore cards, and the GM view's tools.
gmGuide.playersNote: The material for running the game (case seeds, threats and the GM's tools) is in a companion book, the **Grimm GM's Guide**.

chapters.title: Lore cards
chapters.intro: Running investigations and recording what the posse learns. The rules players use are in the *Lore cards* chapter of the Players' Guide; here is the GM view's Discovery panel, for clocks and cards.

discovery.subject: a Wesen, a creature or a curse, and how it is beaten
phases: Effects without a cause: a body drained white, cattle torn open, a town gone too quiet. You may suspect, but nothing is confirmed.

Name the creature. This is the gate: until its identity is confirmed, what you know about a kind of creature doesn't yet apply to this one, and your theories stay suspicions. You can still form hypotheses, test them and take ordinary precautions, and whatever is actually true of it works.
Learn how it is beaten. Filling this phase fills the clock and earns a lore card for what you established.

threat.name: Harvest
threat.text: While you dig, the creature is still hunting. The Harvest clock (4 or 6 segments, one per job) ticks once for each scene spent investigating and once for each failed investigation roll. Each time it fills, the creature claims another victim, and the clock starts again. The dread is the race: learn its weakness before it takes someone you were protecting.

searching private property, leaning on officials, aggressive questioning

asking about Wesen openly, a woge or a spell seen, poking at the uncanny where people can see
the Royals' records, the Order's archives, getting close to the threat
methods: A body, a wound, a scorched doorframe, what the creature left behind.
Prints, broken brush, where the dogs won't go.
Survivors, neighbors, the drunk who saw something.
Court files, old newspapers, land deeds, the parish register.
Grimoires, folk tales, a letter from a hunter long dead.
The man who knows more than he says. Always ticks Suspicion on a failure.

groups.learned: natural identifiers: Occult, Medicine and the archives

discovery.origins: A **Grimm** sees a Wesen's true face: looking can advance Confront or Identify where nothing else would. An **Incantare** can work a ritual of seeing as a method, and **Wesen** know their own kind.
subjects: blutbad
Blutbad
Relentless once it has the scent: wounds don't slow it until it's badly hurt. It can be reasoned with before the hunt starts, not after.
Talking one down before the woge; luring it with blood.
siegbarste
Siegbarste
Bullets and blades barely mark it; its bones are iron. Siegbarste gift (a poison in the drink) weakens it.
Getting the gift into it; a called shot it can't shrug off.
hexenbiest
Hexenbiest
Grimm blood drunk under a full moon ends her power until the Contaminatio Ritualis restores it.
Stripping her power; bargaining with what she fears losing.
wendigo
Wendigo
It drags victims away alive and keeps a larder; the cache can be found.
Finding the larder before it eats; trapping it there.
mauvais
Mauvais Dentes
A royal hound: it hunts one named target and doesn't stop until it or the target is dead.
Using the target as bait; learning who sent it.
hundjager
Hundjäger
They hunt in threes and strike together at whoever an ally hit.
Splitting the pack; turning their master's orders against them.
routes: filled to the end of Uncover
direct experience, or a sensible experiment

reliable transmitted experience: a survivor, a grimoire, church archives, the Royals' letters, a Grimm family's books. A source's reputation alone doesn't make it right, but a reliable account can establish a fact without anyone repeating a dangerous test
what a supernatural creature says, supported by evidence
discovery.anyway: A real weakness works whoever uses it, lore card or no lore card: silver marks its extra box fired by someone who has never heard of werewolves, and a hunter who suspects silver can load it. Called shots follow the ordinary combat rules. An unfamiliar ritual still needs its procedure, the knowledge, the skill and the components.
discovery.basis: folklore the characters have heard, evidence, testimony, their own experience, or a suspicion they can explain
